decision_rule.text: Replication of module M4b (the date/time slot-contract revision, slot store v2) on TRAIN Fold A. Let R be this replicate, B4b the first pass and A the sealed dual-store anchor, all on the same 1,080 rows with the same paired whole-speaker cluster bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915). CLAUSE 1 (the replication clause, the same three clauses cell B4b passed, applied unchanged to R): R is REPLICATED if and only if the CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU micro F1 delta (R minus A) is greater than 0, AND intent (joint scenario+action) is non-inferior within 1.0051 pp -- the CI95 lower bound of (R minus A) exceeds -1.0051 -- AND the projection-v3 reading of the pooled SLU delta agrees in sign with the unprojected one. Read exactly once, from the single official score of the complete manifest. CLAUSE 2 (the own null of the ADMITTED configuration): h_SLU_M4b and h_intent_M4b are the CI95 half-widths of (R minus B4b) for pooled SLU and intent respectively, on the same rows at the same interval level. They are OUTPUTS of this cell, not inputs: no value is written anywhere in this registration and none may be chosen after the fact. They are reported beside the B0r-measured review-off half-widths 1.1218 and 1.0051, which are what the B4b verdict had to borrow. CLAUSE 3 (the consequence): on REPLICATED the provisional obligation of the M4b harness-admission entry is MET, a second entry records the replication, the first entry stays, and the SLURP default plan may carry the slot-contracts-v2 release and snapshot pins. If clause 1 fails, the entry stays provisional with its obligation UNMET, the default plan keeps the v1 pins and the owner is told. NO THIRD PASS of this configuration is registered or authorized either way. CLAUSE 4 (mandatory tables): the full 18-scenario table in both the natural-mixture and the equal-scenario weighting, plus the owner-decision-17 diagnostic -- net harmed rows per scenario, with any scenario at five or more flagged -- for both the (R minus A) and the (R minus B4b) contrasts. CLAUSE 5 (the symmetric scorer): if the TRAIN sibling of slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1 that owner decision 14 orders is registered by the time this cell is read, its numbers are reported beside every official number; if it is not, 'not evaluable on TRAIN' stays the honest statement, exactly as cells B0r and B4b recorded. Diagnostics reported beside the rule and never used for it: the (R minus B4b) point estimates, saves/harms/ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p, the per-type slot diagnostics of the B4b verdict recomputed on R's sealed outputs, the per-scenario intent band of B4b's own clause 4, and R's contacts, GPU hours and duty cycle.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster/role-graph/prompt/geometry/cap change or silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes this flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.

first_pass_numbers_being_replicated.why_a_replicate: The B4b verdict is one pass. Its margins are cell B0r's own null, measured on the same roster and geometry but on a DIFFERENT configuration (review-off, two contacts per row), and its anchor leg is a single realisation shared with every other cell built on it. The family rule of 2026-09-08 requires a replicate or a named root cause before a module is frozen, and the M4b harness-admission entry carries that as an explicit provisional obligation with state UNMET.
